questions.stem: What is the difference between the average of first 50 even natural numbers and the average of first 50 odd natural numbers ?

Three amounts \(x\), \(y\), \(z\) are such that \(y\) is the compound interest on \(x\); and \(z\) is the compound interest on \(y\). The rate of interest per annum and the time period in years are same. Which one of the following is correct ?

There are \(n\) concentric squares. The area of the innermost square is 1 unit and the distance between corresponding corners of any two consecutive squares is 1 unit. Consider the following statements :

I. The diagonal of the \(n\)th square is \(2n + \sqrt{2} - 2\)

II. The area included between \(n\)th square and \((n - 1)\)th square is independent of \(n\)

Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
In a rectangle \(ABCD\), \(AC\) is one of the diagonals. If \(AC + AB = 3AD\) and \(AC - AD = 4\) units, then what is the area of the triangle ?
flags: Stem asks for 'the area of the triangle' but names no triangle - the only figure named is rectangle ABCD and its diagonal AC. Transcribed exactly as printed; verified at high zoom that no triangle label is present.

questions.stem: The area of the circle circumscribing three identical circles touching each other is \(\frac{\pi\left(2 + \sqrt{3}\right)^2}{3}\) square cm. What is the radius of one of the smaller circles ?
In a triangle \(ABC\), \(AB = 21\) cm, \(BC = 20\) cm and \(CA = 13\) cm. A perpendicular \(CD\) is drawn upon the longest side. What is the area of the triangle \(BCD\) ?

There are two containers \(A\) and \(B\). In container \(A\), the ratio of milk and water is \(1 : 3\) and in container \(B\), the ratio of milk and water is \(m : n\). If the mixture in the containers \(A\) and \(B\) are mixed in the ratio \(2 : 3\) to get 20 litres of a mixture having milk and water in the ratio \(3 : 7\), then what is the value of \(\frac{m}{n}\) ?

A cone, a hemisphere and a cylinder stand on equal base of radius \(r\) and have the same height. If the sum of volumes of cone, the hemisphere and the cylinder is equal to volume of a sphere of radius \(R\), then what is \(\frac{R^3}{r^3}\) equal to ?

If \(x^3 + px^2 + qx + r\) is an integer for all integral values of \(x\), then consider the following statements :

I. \(p\) must be an integer

II. \(q\) must be an integer

III. \(r\) must be an integer

Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?

options.label: D
options.text: None of the statements is correct

flags: Subtopic invented - the Polynomials chapter has no subtopic covering integer-valued polynomials / integrality of coefficients. Closest listed is 'Degree and Coefficients', which was judged a poor fit.

questions.stem: \(XYZ\) is a 3-digit number, where \(X\), \(Y\), \(Z\) are distinct non-zero digits. The difference between the two 3-digit numbers \(XYZ\) and \(YXZ\) is 90. How many possible values exist for the sum \((X + Y)\) ?
How many times does the minute hand of a clock coincide with the second hand between 2.01 pm and 4.01 pm on the same day ?
flags: Subtopic invented - the catalog has no Clocks chapter or subtopic anywhere; filed under the closest chapter (relative motion of hands).
The booklet prints the two times with its raised middle dot (2·01 pm, 4·01 pm); transcribed with a full stop per the notation rule. These are clock times, not decimal quantities.

questions.stem: What is the HCF of \(2^{36} - 1\) and \(2^{45} - 1\) ?

The section of a solid right circular cone by a plane containing vertex and perpendicular to base is an equilateral triangle of side 14 cm. What is the volume of the cone ? \(\left(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\right)\)

Three identical cones each with base radius 3 cm are placed on their bases so that each is touching the other two. There will be one and only circle that would pass through each of the vertices of the cones. What is the area of the circle ?
A circle is inscribed in a triangle \(ABC\) right-angled at \(B\). If \(AB = 5\) cm and \(BC = 12\) cm, then what is the radius of the circle ?
The ratio of sum of interior angles to sum of exterior angles of a regular polygon of \(n\) sides is \(\frac{7}{2}\). What is the measure of an interior angle of polygon ?
questions.subtopic: Interior and Exterior Angles of Polygons

questions.stem: The number 199 can be written as \(m^2 - n^2\), where \(m\), \(n\) are natural numbers \((m > n)\). What is the value of \(mn\) ?
How many numbers of the form \(2^n - 1\) and less than 2000 are prime ?

In a class of 160 students, each of them opt at least one language from among English, Hindi and Sanskrit. It is found that 130 students opt English, 120 students Hindi and 110 Sanskrit. If the students opt either only one language or all three languages, then what is the number of students who study all three languages ?
questions.subtopic: Counting Sets, Subsets and Inclusion Exclusion

questions.stem: Let \(S = 5^a + 7^b + 11^c + 13^d\), where \(a\), \(b\), \(c\) and \(d\) are natural numbers. What is the number of distinct remainders of \(S\) when it is divided by 10 ?
In a right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle A = 90^\circ\) and \(AD\) is perpendicular to \(BC\). If \(\angle CAD = 60^\circ\) and \(BC = 6\) cm, then what is \(AB\) equal to ?
